# Clean up PVM packages

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

I wanted to add `resetJAM` method to the debugger adapter, but eventually ended up
lowering the number of PVM packages.

After refactor with pvm-interface, the PVM debugger was missing a lot of previously exported entries. These entries mostly live in `pvm-interpreter` package, but were not exported. While I agree it's a bit suboptimal to expose so many internal details, I think that the best solution would be to split all pvm-interpreter utilities from the actual interpreter (argument parsing, program parsing, etc).
Before this PR only `pvm-program` and `pvm-spi-decoder` were in it's own packages, but imho the split was not very good (we had `pvm-interface -> pvm-program -> pvm-spi-decoder` dependency chain). I've decided to bundle everything together so that we can later on decide on a cleaner split.

Having everything in one packages for now makes it much easier to explore from documentation perspective and also when using `@typeberry/lib` since we can rely on auto-completion.

## Walkthrough

This pull request consolidates the PVM infrastructure by removing three standalone packages (`@typeberry/pvm-program`, `@typeberry/pvm-spi-decoder`, and `@typeberry/pvm-debugger-adapter`), relocating their functionality into `@typeberry/pvm-interpreter`, and introducing `@typeberry/pvm-interface` as a new interface contract. The changes include: removing workspace and monorepo references to deprecated packages, updating all imports across 40+ files to point to the new module locations, restructuring public exports to use broader wildcard re-export patterns instead of selective named exports, and modifying method signatures in debugger-adapter and interpreter classes to include optional parameters for metadata handling.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~50 minutes

- **Import path consolidation**: 25+ test files and core modules updated from `@typeberry/pvm-spi-decoder` to `@typeberry/pvm-interpreter/spi-decoder` require verification that all paths resolve correctly
- **Package.json dependency reorganization**: Multiple package manifests modified; verify version compatibility and that no circular dependencies are introduced across `bin/lib`, `bin/convert`, `packages/core/pvm-interpreter`, and `packages/jam` modules
- **Public API surface changes**: Broad shift from named exports to wildcard re-exports across `pvm-interpreter/index.ts`, `memory/index.ts`, and new barrel files; verify this doesn't expose internal symbols or break existing consumers
- **Method signature changes**: `resetJam()` in Interpreter and debuggerAdapter with added `hasMetadata` parameter; verify all call sites are updated and default behavior is preserved
- **Package deletion impact**: Complete removal of `pvm-program` and `pvm-spi-decoder` packages; ensure no orphaned references or broken transitive dependencies remain in the dependency graph

## Possibly related issues

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#736 — The refactoring aligns with the goal of reducing direct interpreter-package dependencies by consolidating into `@typeberry/pvm-interface` and `@typeberry/pvm-interpreter`, removing separate `pvm-program` and `pvm-spi-decoder` packages.

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#785 — Both PRs consolidate debugger-adapter exports and restructure `bin/lib/index.ts` to re-export pvm-related symbols from `pvm-interface` and `pvm-interpreter` instead of separate packages.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#584 — Both PRs modify the same public export surface in `bin/lib/index.ts` and reorganize which `@typeberry/pvm-*` modules are re-exported.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#365 — Both PRs modify program initialization with metadata handling, including the `hasMetadata` parameter propagation in `Program.fromSpi()` and related method signatures.
